name: Easy AI SEO
author: easyai2025

sections.description:
IMPORTANT: To use Easy AI SEO, you must first create an account with OpenAI, generate an API key, and fund your API account. By connecting directly to OpenAI, you avoid middlemen and inflated credit prices that other AI applications charge.

Easy AI SEO is designed to help you create SEO suggestions using artificial intelligence in the simplest possible format. It is ideal for beginners and for those intimidated by SEO. The plugin can answer questions or generate content by using General AI Query, SEO keyword suggestions, content improvement recommendations, suggest SEO for images and even image generation ideas—all via AI, with the only quantity limit being your API funding. And even more to come. The suggestions are produced using your content on the page and are meant to be manually placed into your SEO program. Create Image SEO directly in the Image page in the Media library. We recommend using Slim SEO or AIOSEO for easy integration of this data into SEO fields—AIOSEO offers more control and feedback while requiring a basic understanding of SEO.

External Services

This plugin relies on external third‑party APIs to provide its AI‑powered SEO suggestions and content improvements. The following details outline which services are used, what data is transmitted, and when:

OpenAI API
What it is & Used For:
The OpenAI API is used to generate SEO keyword suggestions, field‑specific recommendations, content replacement ideas, headline improvements, voice search optimization suggestions, readability improvements, and image generation (via DALL·E 3).
What Data is Sent & When:

Data Sent: The plugin transmits textual content from your post (including title, content, meta fields, and focus keywords) and custom query prompts. Your OpenAI API key is used solely for authentication with OpenAI.
When: Data is sent each time you use features such as generating SEO keywords, improving content, or creating custom images.
Links:
OpenAI Terms of Use – https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
OpenAI Privacy Policy – https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Additional Notes

Easy AI SEO is built to simplify the creation of SEO suggestions using AI. It does not automatically populate your SEO fields; instead, it gives you suggestions that you then input into your SEO plugin (we recommend AIOSEO for ease of use). For more details, please refer to the plugin page on WordPress.org.

This is the initial release of Easy AI SEO. Upgrade if you want access to the premium features.

sections.installation:
1. Click Install Now.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Easy AI SEO and enter your OpenAI API key. (Remember: you must have an OpenAI account and a funded API key.) This is much cheaper than having to use a system where you buy credits at inflated prices.
  4. Enjoy the free features for generating SEO keyword suggestions, content ideas, and more.
  5. For premium features (such as content replacement suggestions, voice search optimization, custom image generation, headline SEO improvements, and link suggestions), upgrade your license via the Freemius integration.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. You must create an account with OpenAI, generate an API key, and fund your API account. This direct connection means you pay only OpenAI’s rates—no middlemen or inflated prices.

Who is this plugin for?

Easy AI SEO is made for beginners and users who find SEO intimidating and time consuming. It provides simple, AI‑generated suggestions for SEO keyword placement and content optimization that you can integrate into other SEO plugins. We highly recommend AIOSEO to easily paste the suggestions into the appropriate fields.

What are the premium features?

The premium version (marked as “Plus Feature” throughout the plugin) includes:
– Content Replacement Suggestions: Natural ways to integrate keywords into your content.
– Improvement Suggestions: Readability and SEO improvement tips.
– Custom Image Generation: Generate images via DALL·E 3.
– Headline SEO Suggestions: Get improved headline ideas.
– Voice Search Optimizations: Receive voice search query suggestions.
– External & Internal Link Suggestions: Propose relevant links.
– Similar Topics Suggestions: Ideas for additional posts.

    • Headline SEO improvements.

    • Similar Topics Suggestions.
